# Galileo AI

> Galileo AI is an observability and evaluation platform that helps teams build reliable, safe, and scalable generative AI applications through real-time monitoring, hallucination detection, and advanced evaluation metrics.

Galileo provides end-to-end solutions for AI reliability including observability tools for RAG systems and agents, guardrails through the Galileo Protect firewall, and Luna-2 small language models for efficient evaluations. The platform serves enterprises looking to monitor, evaluate, and secure their GenAI deployments in production.

## Key Topics

- AI Observability
- AI Evaluation
- RAG Systems
- Hallucination Detection
- Guardrails
- LLM Monitoring
- AI Agents
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Luna-2
- Galileo Protect
- LLM-as-a-Judge
- Eval Engineering
- Context Engineering
- AI Reliability
- Prompt Injection

- [Galileo AI: The AI Observability and Evaluation Platform](https://galileo.ai): Galileo AI observability & evaluation platform for GenAI apps

- [Galileo Protect: Real-Time Hallucination Firewall](https://galileo.ai/protect): Galileo Protect firewall for hallucinations & prompt injection
- [Luna-2 | Galileo's Small Language Models for AI Evaluations](https://galileo.ai/luna-2): Luna-2 SLMs for fast, low-cost agentic evaluations & guardrails
